title: QR Code
description: A real QR code, encoded in your page by a zero-dependency script written from the spec — no library, no image service.
usage: Give the element a data-qr with the text (a URL, up to 106 bytes at error level M, versions 1–6). The script encodes it — byte mode, Reed–Solomon, mask by the penalty rules — and draws an SVG. Because the encoder is the part, codes work offline and never phone a generator service.
a11y: The SVG is an image of data: give the element an aria-label with the destination in words ("Link to kata-ui.dev"), and never make the code the only way to reach it — print the URL beside it for everyone the camera fails.
